mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 underperforms due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (3-month average) (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, supporting corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.3% month-over-month (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion. When both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it signals strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * GDPC1) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 2.5%), the S&P 500 underperforms due to central bank tightening and reduced real returns, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
